text: [University: SZABIST | Category: eligibility] For admission in the BBA/BABS/BS programs, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) and A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution. BE Mechatronic For admission in the BE Mechatronic program, the candidate must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) and Matric/O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects: English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies) in Science group with minimum 60% marks.

[University: SZABIST | Category: eligibility] BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence For admission to the BS Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence program, the candidates must have completed Intermediate in Pre-Engineering/ Computer Science/ Pre-Medical/ with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) OR A-levels (minimum 3 subjects) or equivalent with a combination of (Physics, Biology/Mathematics, and Computer Science/Chemistry) with a minimum of 50% marks, and Matric / O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies). Candidates with a DAE qualification are also eligible to apply. BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5 years For admission in the BS (Accounting & Finance) 2.5-year program, the candidate must have completed O-Levels (minimum 8 subjects including 5 compulsory subjects; English, Urdu, Maths, Islamiat & Pakistan Studies), A-levels (minimum 3 Subjects)/12th Grade/Intermediate with minimum 50% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution and Certificate in Accounting & Finance (CAF) duly verified by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP).

[University: SZABIST | Category: eligibility] LLB University of London (Recognized Teaching Centre) To be eligible to register for this LLB program, you must normally be at least 17 years of age and one of the following should be applicable: three subjects at GCE A level (with one A Level at not less than grade D) two subjects at GCE A level, and at least three further subjects at GCSE/ GCE O level (at not less than grade C) three subjects at GCE A level, and one further subject at GCSE/GCEO Level (at not less than grade C) two subjects at GCE A Level, and two further subjects at AS Level. (Given in the last 3 years) Certificate of Higher Education in Common Law (CertHE) To be eligible to register for this CertHE programme, you must be at least 18 years of age and Intermediate with minimum 55% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution. Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED) For admission in the diploma Early Childhood Education and Development (ECED), the candidate must have completed Intermediate with minimum of 45% marks or equivalent from a recognized institution.
